admission.justification: The delegation default, Manager three-way authority boundary, standing routine paired closeout with Curator zero-stale proof, parented handover routing, and nonsemantic wake boundary jointly guarantee single-coordinator authority under the Architect across instructions and launcher code.

guarantee: Across role, operation, template, manifest and launch-handover sources, a delegating Architect hands coordination to one Manager for one master or one Orchestrator across concurrent masters (with one Manager per master). The Manager operates under one explicit three-way boundary separating its own execution, construction, precedent-covered, planned-gap skeleton and standing routine paired-closeout decisions (across all masters including standalone masters, backed by passing reviews, listed final checks, clean preview, unwaived evidence map and Curator's exact-pair zero-stale dependent-document read) from named Architect matters and the five developer-decision categories. An Orchestrator forwards its Manager's Architect matters unchanged except direct qualifying skeletons (whose first-message direct Architect ID appears only on corroborated receipt lineage); Architect case rulings name only the Architect outcome without reclaiming Manager authority; coordinators send no status-only messages and Managers record working-child or already-sent developer-question waits locally as named waits; permission notices, closeout-result notices, final report-path returns and nonsemantic host wake metadata keep their boundaries, and developer-chosen direct coordination or a single-master Orchestrator remain the only named exceptions.
title: One coordinating agent under the architect
